# Hummingbird and kingfisher animation variants

[← Back to all cases](../../README.md#all-cases)

<a href="README.md"><img src="../../assets/badges/language-en-current.svg" alt="Current language: English" height="34" /></a> <a href="README.zh-CN.md"><img src="../../assets/badges/language-zh-CN.svg" alt="View translation: 简体中文" height="34" /></a>

**Creator-reported model · Source-only; not independently reproduced**

The first two attachments show a hummingbird beside a pink hibiscus; the last two show a kingfisher above water. All four X-served MP4s and the first poster are archived and the MP4s decode successfully. The creator describes a nine-frame-to-24-fps workflow; the delivered MP4 metadata is 10, 10, about 8.33 and 5.26 fps respectively, which does not independently establish the original generation/interpolation workflow. Count the attachments as one case. Published 2026-11-05 00:30 UTC. No original GIF or sprite sheet was verified.
